earlierFailures: Earlier failed runs are retained as failures: the first targeted default run had two confirmation request errors because an omitted primitive duplicate flag failed JSON deserialization; the fix normalizes omitted/null to false. The next targeted run had six missing business-profile fixture errors and two insufficient-scoring-fixture failures. Fixtures were completed with real required parent rows and known synthetic repayment evidence. The new pilot browser fixture likewise needed sufficient unchanged scoring inputs while preserving its zero/null assertions. F02 mobile width initially failed before the Urdu font/viewport settled; the test now awaits fonts and two animation frames before the unchanged width assertion and records measured layout diagnostics (390px viewport/390px scroll width, no overflowing elements). The first full regression had one older deliberate-edit test omit expectedVersion; it now submits the initial response version and asserts version advancement while retaining all snapshot-replacement/null assertions. A subsequent full run exposed the new migration fixture leaving a plaintext full name in the shared disposable database; the fixture now uses the existing encryption implementation and test key, preserving strict authentication decryption and all privilege assertions. No assertions, score policy, encryption policy or concurrency checks were weakened. The corrected targeted, browser and final full runs pass.
